title: Outstanding Visit - poor instructions from Tripadvisor
text: Our visit to the Alhambra was a once in a lifetime experience - the tour guide was exceptional. This is a must do when you visit Granada, However. The trip advisor website is a major let down. Our booking  description was changed leaving us uncertain what we were walking into - PASSPORTS; at no point in the description or the conformation email was the importance of carrying our passport explained - the arrival departure information is also to vague !! NOT Good Tripadvisor !!
author: 888craigs

title: Great tour!
text: The tour was amazing, and Juan was a great guide. The group was small, and we were taken through the entire palace and gardens, and the explanations were interesting. Highly recommend this tour!

title: A 10
text: I made the excursion together with my mother, grandmother and daughter, on 28/03/26. Our guide was Jorge, and I don't know if we could have had a better one. Apart from a very good professional, he was close, attentive, fun and very mindful of including my daughter (10 years old) in the theme of the visit, and also took into account my grandmother (84 years old) pausing and looking for a place where she could sit for a few minutes while explaining everything with great energy. We give it a 10. Thank you so much!!
